name: HCC Memory
description: Bridges OpenClaw memory to HCC (Hanyan Cognitive Core) REST API for hybrid search, recall, and durable storage

baseUrl.description: HCC gateway base URL, e.g. http://100.66.103.69:8000

userId.description: HCC user_id to scope memories under

agentId.description: HCC agent_id to scope memories under

sessionRecallEnabled.description: Enable session_start auto-recall + prependSystemContext injection (default true)

sessionRecallLimit.description: Max auto-recalled memories injected at session start (default 5)

emotionEnabled.description: Enable emotion warm-start at session start and emotion write-back at session end (default true)

fetchTimeoutMs.description: Abort timeout for HCC API calls, ms (default 8000)

crossAgentSearch.description: When true (default), active memory reads (memory_search / memory_get / capability search) drop the agent_id filter so this runtime can retrieve memories written by the other runtimes sharing this HCC (hermes / claude-code / hanyan). Writes and emotion stay scoped to agentId. Set false to box search to this agent's own memories.
